summary: Tests and migration evidence were added, but Swift is not installed in this container; `swift package resolve` and `swift test --disable-sandbox` could not run. The measurement payload test is intentionally red until the implementation run replaces hand-written payload models with generated OpenAPI types.

references.result: Package resolution and a pinned generated client are deferred to the implementation run.
The upstream schema has all six paths, but the app has no ranked-results operation and its published ranked-results schema is incomplete.
Replacing hand-written wire models is implementation work and has not occurred in this tests-only run.
Local MockURLProtocol coverage was added for manifest and recent-sheet responses; execution was blocked because Swift is unavailable.
This intentional red test requires the generated measurement request to omit undocumented fields.
Contract deltas and endpoint gaps are prepared for the implementation PR description, which has not been published in this run.
